//: Type-checks webcrypto.js against the Web Cryptography API definitions
TypeScript ships: `interface-check.js` asserts the exported subset against
`SubtleCrypto` and `CryptoKey`. Nothing is generated, so nothing goes stale.
`lib` is DOM because that is where the specification being implemented
lives. The componentize-js runtime provides none of it — the module
supplies its own `DOMException` stand-in — but the shapes it must match
